notes.title: Update 0.1.1
notes.notes:
Update notes: 

[list]
[*] Inventory system now unlocked for use in PVP & PVE with 3 item classes (artifacts, consumables, gadgets)
[*]  Loading screen freeze issues resolved
[*]  Lobby shops unlocked with accurate price display
[*]  Astra earned per daily mission completed updated to 200 Astra
[*]  Astra earned per PVP match won updated to 150 Astra
[*]  Astra earned per PVP match lost updated to 50 Astra
[*]  XP gained from PVP match won is now accurate
[*]  Player's ranks are now shown next to name in lobby/Mayhem
[*]  UI changes to show currencies with more accuracy
[*]  Mist projectile speed increased for greater accuracy
[*]  Volume settings fixed, no more extreme loud volume
[*]  Rapunzel and Aurora freeze bugs resolved
[*]  Game pauses on pressing esc for PVE modes
[*]  Avalon and Aurora dash stamina consumption increased
[*]  Wrong attack descriptions for Aurora and Dainsleif corrected
[*]  Rapunzel health and movement speed increased
[*]  Tier system introduced for repeat characters for Gacha
[*]  Mist damage during Afterburner increased
[*]  Rapunzel attack damage increased by 15%
[*]  UI toggle removed
